upstream_repository_license: GPL-3.0; upstream LICENSE retained verbatim alongside these files
transformations: Source CSVs are unchanged. Derived maps use coordinates; DBSCAN gives every recorded location equal weight, without using DEATHS or pump locations. DEATHS is summed only for descriptive reporting.
limits: Counts describe these files, not the entire outbreak. Original digitization and completeness have not been independently verified. No population denominators, individual water-use observations, dates of deaths, walking network, controls or causal labels are present. No upstream notebook code, images or video were copied.
